info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Customer Access Entitlement Management API
info.description: The Customer Access Entitlement Management API allows financial institutions to modify access entitlements for customers. This API facilitates the management of permissions associated with customer banking operations, enabling institutions to customize access based on business requirements. Typical consumers include banking administrators and compliance officers who require precise control over customer access levels. The endpoint supports updates to existing configurations, ensuring that customer entitlements reflect up-to-date business policies and regulatory obligations.

put.description: This endpoint allows the updating of customer access entitlement for a specific customer identified by CUST-100045. Make sure to provide the necessary data in the request body to reflect the changes required.
